title: Unique Garlicky Canadian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and cozy Canadian dish featuring lamb, garlic, and oregano, perfect for a cold winter's night. This satvik-friendly stew is made with fresh and natural ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb cubes, minced garlic, and dried oregano, and mix well to coat the lamb evenly.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat, then add the lamb mixture and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and cubed potatoes to the pot, and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the lamb broth and tomato paste to the pot, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer the stew for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
After 1 hour of cooking, prepare an ice bath by filling a large bowl with ice and water.
Once the stew is cooked, remove the pot from the heat and carefully place it into the ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Let the stew cool slightly, then serve hot, garnished with fresh oregano if desired.
